question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**This**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence structure requires a demonstrative pronoun to refer back to '**species of animal**', which is singular.
 
• '**This**' is used as a demonstrative pronoun to refer to a single noun mentioned previously in the sentence or context. It indicates something that is close to the speaker in terms of distance or conceptually. In this sentence, 'This' refers to the particular species of animal being discussed, implying closeness or directness in the context.
 
• The singular nature of '**species**' demands a singular demonstrative pronoun, making '**This**' the correct choice.
